regenerate_remoting_codebase: run the regenerate_remoting.py script to regenerate GGML virtgpu remoting header files from YAML config
create_remoting_generator: create a RemotingCodebaseGenerator instance with a custom YAML config path for GGML remoting code generation
build_backend_dispatch_table: build the backend dispatch table header with function declarations and enum mappings for GGML remoting
get_enabled_functions: get all enabled GGML remoting functions with their enum names, backend/frontend function names, and metadata
generate_backend_header: generate the apir_backend.gen.h header file with enum definitions and dispatch command name function
